sections.voiceover: BMW Group's driverless system moved 1,000,000 vehicles across factories from Dingolfing to Oxford.
How did the Oxford plant reach 53,000 moves in 2025?
Yet the system's availability stayed above 99.5 % despite the volume.
BMW's automated vehicle system achieved over 99.5% operational availability for production vehicle movements. Oxford's plant alone logged more than 53,000 driverless vehicle movements during 2025.
Follow BMW Group's network handling 3,500 daily moves across Dingolfing, Leipzig, Regensburg, and Oxford.
